pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar"
try
set baseDate to current date
set year of baseDate to 2025
set month of baseDate to October
set day of baseDate to 29
set hours of baseDate to 0
set minutes of baseDate to 0
set seconds of baseDate to 0
set targetDate to baseDate
set nextDay to targetDate + (1 * days)
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
set eventsOnDate to (every event of currentCalendar whose start date ≥ targetDate and start date < nextDay)
repeat with currentEvent in eventsOnDate
set eventSummary to summary of currentEvent
if eventSummary is "Project Deadline Review" then
delete currentEvent
end if
end repeat
end repeat
return true
on error
return false
end try
end tell' && osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar" to quit' && sleep 2
instruction: Create a new event titled 'Project Deadline Review' for October 29, 2025, from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM, and set a reminder to alert 15 minutes before the event.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events"
if not (exists process "Calendar") then
return false
end if
end tell
tell application "Calendar"
try
set baseDate to (current date)
set year of baseDate to 2025
set month of baseDate to October
set day of baseDate to 29
set hours of baseDate to 0
set minutes of baseDate to 0
set seconds of baseDate to 0
set targetDate to baseDate
set nextDay to targetDate + (1 * days)
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
try
set eventsOnDate to (every event of currentCalendar whose start date ≥ targetDate and start date < nextDay)
repeat with currentEvent in eventsOnDate
try
set eventSummary to summary of currentEvent
if eventSummary is "Project Deadline Review" then
set eventStartDate to start date of currentEvent
set eventEndDate to end date of currentEvent
set startTime to time of eventStartDate
set endTime to time of eventEndDate
set startHours to startTime div hours
set startMinutes to (startTime mod hours) div minutes
set endHours to endTime div hours
set endMinutes to (endTime mod hours) div minutes
if startHours is 14 and startMinutes is 0 and endHours is 15 and endMinutes is 0 then
try
repeat with currentReminder in display alarms of currentEvent
set reminderOffset to trigger interval of currentReminder
if reminderOffset is -15 then
return true
end if
end repeat
return false
on error
return false
end try
else
return false
end if
end if
on error
end try
end repeat
on error
end try
end repeat
return false
on error
return false
end try
end tell'
